+std::vector<ElementDynamic> gatherResults(const std::vector<val_t>& local_energy,
+                                          const std::vector<val_t>& local_flux,
+                                          const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                                          int n_elems_root) {
+    if (local_energy.size() > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        abortWithMessage("MPI", "MPI_Gatherv count", "local domain is too large",
+                         __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+
+    const int local_count = static_cast<int>(local_energy.size());
+    const int metadata[4] = {decomposition.x_start, decomposition.y_start,
+                             decomposition.nx, decomposition.ny};
+    std::vector<int> all_metadata;
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        all_metadata.resize(static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.size) * 4);
+        counts.resize(decomposition.size);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gather(metadata, 4, MPI_INT, all_metadata.data(), 4, MPI_INT,
+                         0, decomposition.cart));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gather(&local_count, 1, MPI_INT, counts.data(), 1, MPI_INT,
+                         0, decomposition.cart));
+
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<val_t> gathered_energy;
+    std::vector<val_t> gathered_flux;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        displacements.resize(decomposition.size);
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int rank = 0; rank < decomposition.size; ++rank) {
+            displacements[rank] = total;
+            if (counts[rank] > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() - total) {
+                abortWithMessage("MPI", "MPI_Gatherv displacement",
+                                 "global result is too large", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+            }
+            total += counts[rank];
+        }
+        gathered_energy.resize(total);
+        gathered_flux.resize(total);
+    }
+
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(local_energy.data(), local_count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          gathered_energy.data(), counts.data(), displacements.data(),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, decomposition.cart));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(local_flux.data(), local_count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          gathered_flux.data(), counts.data(), displacements.data(),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, decomposition.cart));
+
+    std::vector<ElementDynamic> global_results;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        global_results.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n_elems_root) * n_elems_root);
+
+        // All OpenMP workers cooperate on each MPI block.  This avoids races
+        // and retains global row-major ordering for output and validation.
+#pragma omp parallel
+        {
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < decomposition.size; ++rank) {
+                const int x_start = all_metadata[4 * rank];
+                const int y_start = all_metadata[4 * rank + 1];
+                const int nx = all_metadata[4 * rank + 2];
+                const int ny = all_metadata[4 * rank + 3];
+#pragma omp for schedule(static)
+                for (int local_index = 0; local_index < counts[rank]; ++local_index) {
+                    const int local_x = local_index / ny;
+                    const int local_y = local_index % ny;
+                    const size_t global_index =
+                        static_cast<size_t>(x_start + local_x) * n_elems_root +
+                        y_start + local_y;
+                    const int gathered_index = displacements[rank] + local_index;
+                    global_results[global_index] =
+                        ElementDynamic{gathered_energy[gathered_index],
+                                       gathered_flux[gathered_index]};
+                }
+                (void)nx;
+            }
+        }
     }
+    return global_results;
 }

+[[noreturn]] void abortWithMessage(const char* kind, const char* expression,
+                                   const char* detail, const char* file, int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s failure at %s:%d: %s (%s)\n",
+                 world_rank, kind, file, line, expression, detail);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+        abortWithMessage("CUDA", expression, cudaGetErrorString(error), file, line);
+    }

+void checkMpi(int error, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+        abortWithMessage("MPI", expression, message, file, line);
+    }
+}

+#define MPI_CHECK(call) checkMpi((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int global_y,
+                                              int n_elems_root) {
+    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && global_y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == last && global_y == last)) {
+        return 0.5;
+    }
+    if ((global_x == 0 && global_y == last) ||
+        (global_x == last && global_y == 0)) {
+        return -0.5;
+    }
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t computeFluxDevice(val_t center,
+                                                   val_t neighbor) {
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations preserve the original CPU
+    // expression's operation boundaries; in particular, CUDA must not fuse
+    // the final multiply with the running flux sum.
+    const val_t difference = __dsub_rn(neighbor, center);
+    const val_t transferred = __dmul_rn(difference, 0.8);
+    return __dmul_rn(transferred, 0.25);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updatePoint(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ energy_swap,
+    val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux_swap,
+    val_t* __restrict__ send_left,
+    val_t* __restrict__ send_right,
+    int local_x, int local_y, int nx, int ny, int pitch,
+    int x_start, int y_start, int n_elems_root) {
+    const int global_x = x_start + local_x - 1;
+    const int global_y = y_start + local_y - 1;
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, global_y, n_elems_root);
+
+    // Keep the original connection order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n_elems_root) {
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index + pitch]));
+    }
+    if (global_x > 0) {
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index - pitch]));
+    }
+    if (global_y + 1 < n_elems_root) {
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index + 1]));
+    }
+    if (global_y > 0) {
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index - 1]));
+    }
+
+    const val_t new_energy = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    energy_swap[index] = new_energy;
+    accumulated_flux_swap[index] =
+        __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[index], fabs(flux));
+
+    // Packing the next iteration's noncontiguous column halos here removes a
+    // separate read of each boundary column.
+    if (local_y == 1) {
+        send_left[local_x - 1] = new_energy;
+    }
+    if (local_y == ny) {
+        send_right[local_x - 1] = new_energy;
+    }
+}
+
+constexpr int TILE_X = 32;
+constexpr int TILE_Y = 8;
+
+__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ energy_swap,
+    val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux_swap,
+    int nx, int ny, int pitch) {
+    __shared__ val_t tile[TILE_Y + 2][TILE_X + 2];
+
+    const int block_row = 2 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * TILE_Y;
+    const int block_col = 2 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * TILE_X;
+    const int linear_thread = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) * TILE_X + threadIdx.x;
+    constexpr int tile_elements = (TILE_Y + 2) * (TILE_X + 2);
+    constexpr int block_threads = TILE_X * TILE_Y;
+
+    for (int item = linear_thread; item < tile_elements; item += block_threads) {
+        const int tile_row = item / (TILE_X + 2);
+        const int tile_col = item % (TILE_X + 2);
+        const int local_x = block_row + tile_row - 1;
+        const int local_y = block_col + tile_col - 1;
+        val_t value = 0.0;
+        if (local_x >= 1 && local_x <= nx && local_y >= 1 && local_y <= ny) {
+            value = energy[static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y];
+        }
+        tile[tile_row][tile_col] = value;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int local_x = block_row + threadIdx.y;
+    const int local_y = block_col + threadIdx.x;
+    if (local_x >= nx || local_y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int shared_x = threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const int shared_y = threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const val_t center = tile[shared_x][shared_y];
+    val_t flux = 0.0;
+    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x + 1][shared_y]));
+    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x - 1][shared_y]));
+    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x][shared_y + 1]));
+    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x][shared_y - 1]));
+
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y;
+    energy_swap[index] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    accumulated_flux_swap[index] =
+        __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[index], fabs(flux));
+}

+    const int item = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    if (item >= boundary_elements) {
+        return;
+    }

+int partitionExtent(int global_extent, int parts, int coordinate) {
+    const int base = global_extent / parts;
+    const int remainder = global_extent % parts;
+    return base + (coordinate < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+}
+
+int partitionStart(int global_extent, int parts, int coordinate) {
+    const int base = global_extent / parts;
+    const int remainder = global_extent % parts;
+    return coordinate * base + std::min(coordinate, remainder);
+}
+
+Decomposition makeDecomposition(int n_elems_root) {
+    Decomposition domain;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &domain.size));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Dims_create(domain.size, 2, domain.dims));
+    if (domain.dims[0] > n_elems_root || domain.dims[1] > n_elems_root) {
+        if (world_rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "The %d x %d MPI process grid exceeds the %d x %d mesh.\n",
+                         domain.dims[0], domain.dims[1], n_elems_root, n_elems_root);
         }
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    }
+
+    const int periods[2] = {0, 0};
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_create(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2, domain.dims, periods, 0,
+                              &domain.cart));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(domain.cart, &domain.rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_coords(domain.cart, domain.rank, 2, domain.coords));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_shift(domain.cart, 0, 1, &domain.x_minus, &domain.x_plus));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_shift(domain.cart, 1, 1, &domain.y_minus, &domain.y_plus));
+
+    domain.nx = partitionExtent(n_elems_root, domain.dims[0], domain.coords[0]);
+    domain.ny = partitionExtent(n_elems_root, domain.dims[1], domain.coords[1]);
+    domain.x_start = partitionStart(n_elems_root, domain.dims[0], domain.coords[0]);
+    domain.y_start = partitionStart(n_elems_root, domain.dims[1], domain.coords[1]);
+    return domain;
+}

+template <typename T>
+void allocateDevice(T** pointer, size_t count) {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+}
+
+bool cudaAwareMpiAvailable() {
+    const char* override_value = std::getenv("UNSTRUCTURED_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (override_value != nullptr) {
+        return std::atoi(override_value) != 0;
+    }
+#if defined(OPEN_MPI) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
+    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#else
+    // Unknown MPI implementations use the portable pinned-memory path.  A
+    // CUDA-aware installation can opt into its direct path with the environment
+    // variable above without requiring a rebuild.
+    return false;
+#endif
+}

+DeviceDomain allocateDeviceDomain(const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                                  bool cuda_aware_mpi) {
+    DeviceDomain device;
+    device.cuda_aware_mpi = cuda_aware_mpi;
+    device.pitch = static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) + 2;
+    device.allocation_elements =
+        (static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) + 2) * device.pitch;
+
+    allocateDevice(&device.energy, device.allocation_elements);
+    allocateDevice(&device.energy_swap, device.allocation_elements);
+    allocateDevice(&device.total_flux, device.allocation_elements);
+    allocateDevice(&device.total_flux_swap, device.allocation_elements);
+    allocateDevice(&device.send_left, decomposition.nx);
+    allocateDevice(&device.send_right, decomposition.nx);
+    allocateDevice(&device.recv_left, decomposition.nx);
+    allocateDevice(&device.recv_right, decomposition.nx);
+    const bool has_neighbor =
+        decomposition.x_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+        decomposition.x_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+        decomposition.y_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+        decomposition.y_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL;
+    if (!device.cuda_aware_mpi && has_neighbor) {
+        const size_t halo_elements =
+            4 * static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) +
+            4 * static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device.host_halos),
+                                  halo_elements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        val_t* halo = device.host_halos;
+        device.host_send_top = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.ny;
+        device.host_send_bottom = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.ny;
+        device.host_recv_top = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.ny;
+        device.host_recv_bottom = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.ny;
+        device.host_send_left = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.nx;
+        device.host_send_right = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.nx;
+        device.host_recv_left = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.nx;
+        device.host_recv_right = halo;
+        std::fill(device.host_halos, device.host_halos + halo_elements, 0.0);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&device.boundary_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_ready[0],
+                                        cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_ready[1],
+                                        cudaEventDisableTiming));
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.energy, 0,
+                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.energy_swap, 0,
+                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.total_flux, 0,
+                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.total_flux_swap, 0,
+                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.recv_left, 0,
+                               static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.recv_right, 0,
+                               static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+
+    constexpr int threads = 256;
+    const int blocks = (decomposition.nx + threads - 1) / threads;
+    packColumnsKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, device.boundary_stream>>>(
+        device.energy, device.send_left, device.send_right,
+        decomposition.nx, decomposition.ny, static_cast<int>(device.pitch));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(device.interior_ready[0], device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(device.interior_ready[1], device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(device.boundary_stream));
+    return device;
+}

+void copyLocalResults(const DeviceDomain& device,
+                      const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                      std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                      std::vector<val_t>& flux) {
+    const size_t local_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * decomposition.ny;
+    energy.resize(local_elements);
+    flux.resize(local_elements);
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) * sizeof(val_t);
+    const val_t* energy_start = device.energy + device.pitch + 1;
+    const val_t* flux_start = device.total_flux + device.pitch + 1;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(energy.data(), row_bytes, energy_start,
+                            device.pitch * sizeof(val_t), row_bytes,
+                            decomposition.nx, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(flux.data(), row_bytes, flux_start,
+                            device.pitch * sizeof(val_t), row_bytes,
+                            decomposition.nx, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+}

+uint64_t computeDistributedHash(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                                const std::vector<val_t>& flux,
+                                const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                                int n_elems_root) {
+    uint64_t local_hash = 0;
+    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : local_hash)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0; local_index < count; ++local_index) {
+        const int local_x = static_cast<int>(local_index / decomposition.ny);
+        const int local_y = static_cast<int>(local_index % decomposition.ny);
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            static_cast<uint64_t>(decomposition.x_start + local_x) * n_elems_root +
+            decomposition.y_start + local_y;
+        uint64_t energy_bits;
+        uint64_t flux_bits;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits, &energy[local_index], sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits, &flux[local_index], sizeof(flux_bits));
+        local_hash ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        local_hash ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    }
+
+    uint64_t global_hash = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_hash, &global_hash, 1, MPI_UINT64_T,
+                         MPI_BXOR, 0, decomposition.cart));
+    return global_hash;
+}
+
+std::vector<ElementDynamic> gatherResults(const std::vector<val_t>& local_energy,
+                                          const std::vector<val_t>& local_flux,
+                                          const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                                          int n_elems_root) {
+    if (local_energy.size() > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        abortWithMessage("MPI", "MPI_Gatherv count", "local domain is too large",
+                         __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+
+    const int local_count = static_cast<int>(local_energy.size());
+    const int metadata[4] = {decomposition.x_start, decomposition.y_start,
+                             decomposition.nx, decomposition.ny};
+    std::vector<int> all_metadata;
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        all_metadata.resize(static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.size) * 4);
+        counts.resize(decomposition.size);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gather(metadata, 4, MPI_INT, all_metadata.data(), 4, MPI_INT,
+                         0, decomposition.cart));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gather(&local_count, 1, MPI_INT, counts.data(), 1, MPI_INT,
+                         0, decomposition.cart));
+
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<val_t> gathered_energy;
+    std::vector<val_t> gathered_flux;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        displacements.resize(decomposition.size);
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int rank = 0; rank < decomposition.size; ++rank) {
+            displacements[rank] = total;
+            if (counts[rank] > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() - total) {
+                abortWithMessage("MPI", "MPI_Gatherv displacement",
+                                 "global result is too large", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+            }
+            total += counts[rank];
+        }
+        gathered_energy.resize(total);
+        gathered_flux.resize(total);
+    }
+
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(local_energy.data(), local_count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          gathered_energy.data(), counts.data(), displacements.data(),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, decomposition.cart));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(local_flux.data(), local_count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          gathered_flux.data(), counts.data(), displacements.data(),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, decomposition.cart));
+
+    std::vector<ElementDynamic> global_results;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        global_results.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n_elems_root) * n_elems_root);
+
+        // All OpenMP workers cooperate on each MPI block.  This avoids races
+        // and retains global row-major ordering for output and validation.
+#pragma omp parallel
+        {
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < decomposition.size; ++rank) {
+                const int x_start = all_metadata[4 * rank];
+                const int y_start = all_metadata[4 * rank + 1];
+                const int nx = all_metadata[4 * rank + 2];
+                const int ny = all_metadata[4 * rank + 3];
+#pragma omp for schedule(static)
+                for (int local_index = 0; local_index < counts[rank]; ++local_index) {
+                    const int local_x = local_index / ny;
+                    const int local_y = local_index % ny;
+                    const size_t global_index =
+                        static_cast<size_t>(x_start + local_x) * n_elems_root +
+                        y_start + local_y;
+                    const int gathered_index = displacements[rank] + local_index;
+                    global_results[global_index] =
+                        ElementDynamic{gathered_energy[gathered_index],
+                                       gathered_flux[gathered_index]};
+                }
+                (void)nx;
+            }
+        }
     }
+    return global_results;
 }

   111	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int global_y,
   112	                                              int n_elems_root) {
   113	    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;
   114	    if ((global_x == 0 && global_y == 0) ||
   115	        (global_x == last && global_y == last)) {
   116	        return 0.5;
   117	    }
   118	    if ((global_x == 0 && global_y == last) ||
   119	        (global_x == last && global_y == 0)) {
   120	        return -0.5;
   120	        return -0.5;
   121	    }
   122	    return 0.0;
   123	}

   125	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t computeFluxDevice(val_t center,
   126	                                                   val_t neighbor) {
   127	    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations preserve the original CPU
   128	    // expression's operation boundaries; in particular, CUDA must not fuse
   129	    // the final multiply with the running flux sum.
   130	    const val_t difference = __dsub_rn(neighbor, center);
   131	    const val_t transferred = __dmul_rn(difference, 0.8);
   132	    return __dmul_rn(transferred, 0.25);
   133	}

   135	__device__ __forceinline__ void updatePoint(
   136	    const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
   137	    const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
   138	    val_t* __restrict__ energy_swap,
   139	    val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux_swap,
   140	    val_t* __restrict__ send_left,
   141	    val_t* __restrict__ send_right,
   142	    int local_x, int local_y, int nx, int ny, int pitch,
   143	    int x_start, int y_start, int n_elems_root) {
   144	    const int global_x = x_start + local_x - 1;
   145	    const int global_y = y_start + local_y - 1;
   146	    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y;
   147	    const val_t center = energy[index];
   148	    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, global_y, n_elems_root);
   149	
   150	    // Keep the original connection order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
   151	    if (global_x + 1 < n_elems_root) {
   152	        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index + pitch]));
   153	    }
   154	    if (global_x > 0) {
   155	        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index - pitch]));
   156	    }
   157	    if (global_y + 1 < n_elems_root) {
   158	        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index + 1]));
   159	    }
   160	    if (global_y > 0) {
   161	        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index - 1]));
   162	    }
   163	
   164	    const val_t new_energy = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
   165	    energy_swap[index] = new_energy;
   166	    accumulated_flux_swap[index] =
   167	        __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[index], fabs(flux));
   168	
   169	    // Packing the next iteration's noncontiguous column halos here removes a
   170	    // separate read of each boundary column.
   171	    if (local_y == 1) {
   172	        send_left[local_x - 1] = new_energy;
   173	    }
   174	    if (local_y == ny) {
   175	        send_right[local_x - 1] = new_energy;
   176	    }
   177	}

   179	constexpr int TILE_X = 32;
   180	constexpr int TILE_Y = 8;

   182	__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
   183	    const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
   184	    const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
   185	    val_t* __restrict__ energy_swap,
   186	    val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux_swap,
   187	    int nx, int ny, int pitch) {
   188	    __shared__ val_t tile[TILE_Y + 2][TILE_X + 2];
   189	
   190	    const int block_row = 2 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * TILE_Y;
   191	    const int block_col = 2 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * TILE_X;
   192	    const int linear_thread = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) * TILE_X + threadIdx.x;
   193	    constexpr int tile_elements = (TILE_Y + 2) * (TILE_X + 2);
   194	    constexpr int block_threads = TILE_X * TILE_Y;
   195	
   196	    for (int item = linear_thread; item < tile_elements; item += block_threads) {
   197	        const int tile_row = item / (TILE_X + 2);
   198	        const int tile_col = item % (TILE_X + 2);
   199	        const int local_x = block_row + tile_row - 1;
   200	        const int local_y = block_col + tile_col - 1;
   201	        val_t value = 0.0;
   202	        if (local_x >= 1 && local_x <= nx && local_y >= 1 && local_y <= ny) {
   203	            value = energy[static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y];
   204	        }
   205	        tile[tile_row][tile_col] = value;
   206	    }
   207	    __syncthreads();
   208	
   209	    const int local_x = block_row + threadIdx.y;
   210	    const int local_y = block_col + threadIdx.x;
   211	    if (local_x >= nx || local_y >= ny) {
   212	        return;
   213	    }
   214	
   215	    const int shared_x = threadIdx.y + 1;
   216	    const int shared_y = threadIdx.x + 1;
   217	    const val_t center = tile[shared_x][shared_y];
   218	    val_t flux = 0.0;
   219	    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x + 1][shared_y]));
   220	    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x - 1][shared_y]));
   221	    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x][shared_y + 1]));
   222	    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x][shared_y - 1]));
   223	
   224	    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y;
   225	    energy_swap[index] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
   226	    accumulated_flux_swap[index] =
   227	        __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[index], fabs(flux));
   228	}

   230	__global__ void updateBoundaryKernel(
   231	    const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
   232	    const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
   233	    val_t* __restrict__ energy_swap,
   234	    val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux_swap,

   237	    int boundary_elements, int nx, int ny, int pitch,

   240	    if (item >= boundary_elements) {
   241	        return;
   242	    }

   244	    int local_x;
   245	    int local_y;
   246	    if (nx == 1) {
   247	        local_x = 1;
   248	        local_y = item + 1;
   249	    } else if (item < ny) {
   250	        local_x = 1;

   301	Decomposition makeDecomposition(int n_elems_root) {
   302	    Decomposition domain;
   303	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &domain.size));
   304	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Dims_create(domain.size, 2, domain.dims));
   305	    if (domain.dims[0] > n_elems_root || domain.dims[1] > n_elems_root) {
   306	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   307	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   308	                         "The %d x %d MPI process grid exceeds the %d x %d mesh.\n",
   309	                         domain.dims[0], domain.dims[1], n_elems_root, n_elems_root);
   310	        }
   311	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
   312	    }
   313	
   314	    const int periods[2] = {0, 0};
   315	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_create(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2, domain.dims, periods, 0,
   316	                              &domain.cart));
   317	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(domain.cart, &domain.rank));
   318	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_coords(domain.cart, domain.rank, 2, domain.coords));
   319	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_shift(domain.cart, 0, 1, &domain.x_minus, &domain.x_plus));
   320	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_shift(domain.cart, 1, 1, &domain.y_minus, &domain.y_plus));
   321	
   322	    domain.nx = partitionExtent(n_elems_root, domain.dims[0], domain.coords[0]);
   323	    domain.ny = partitionExtent(n_elems_root, domain.dims[1], domain.coords[1]);
   324	    domain.x_start = partitionStart(n_elems_root, domain.dims[0], domain.coords[0]);
   325	    domain.y_start = partitionStart(n_elems_root, domain.dims[1], domain.coords[1]);
   326	    return domain;
   327	}

   329	template <typename T>
   330	void allocateDevice(T** pointer, size_t count) {
   331	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
   332	}
   333	
   334	bool cudaAwareMpiAvailable() {
   335	    const char* override_value = std::getenv("UNSTRUCTURED_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
   336	    if (override_value != nullptr) {
   337	        return std::atoi(override_value) != 0;
   338	    }
   339	#if defined(OPEN_MPI) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
   340	    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
   341	#else
   342	    // Unknown MPI implementations use the portable pinned-memory path.  A
   343	    // CUDA-aware installation can opt into its direct path with the environment
   344	    // variable above without requiring a rebuild.
   345	    return false;
   346	#endif
   347	}

   349	DeviceDomain allocateDeviceDomain(const Decomposition& decomposition,
   350	                                  bool cuda_aware_mpi) {
   351	    DeviceDomain device;
   352	    device.cuda_aware_mpi = cuda_aware_mpi;
   353	    device.pitch = static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) + 2;
   354	    device.allocation_elements =
   355	        (static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) + 2) * device.pitch;
   356	
   357	    allocateDevice(&device.energy, device.allocation_elements);
   358	    allocateDevice(&device.energy_swap, device.allocation_elements);
   359	    allocateDevice(&device.total_flux, device.allocation_elements);
   360	    allocateDevice(&device.total_flux_swap, device.allocation_elements);
   361	    allocateDevice(&device.send_left, decomposition.nx);
   362	    allocateDevice(&device.send_right, decomposition.nx);
   363	    allocateDevice(&device.recv_left, decomposition.nx);
   364	    allocateDevice(&device.recv_right, decomposition.nx);
   365	    const bool has_neighbor =
   366	        decomposition.x_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
   367	        decomposition.x_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
   368	        decomposition.y_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
   369	        decomposition.y_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL;
   370	    if (!device.cuda_aware_mpi && has_neighbor) {
   371	        const size_t halo_elements =
   372	            4 * static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) +
   373	            4 * static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx);
   374	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device.host_halos),
   375	                                  halo_elements * sizeof(val_t)));
   376	        val_t* halo = device.host_halos;
   377	        device.host_send_top = halo;
   378	        halo += decomposition.ny;
   379	        device.host_send_bottom = halo;
   380	        halo += decomposition.ny;
   381	        device.host_recv_top = halo;
   382	        halo += decomposition.ny;
   383	        device.host_recv_bottom = halo;
   384	        halo += decomposition.ny;
   385	        device.host_send_left = halo;
   386	        halo += decomposition.nx;
   387	        device.host_send_right = halo;
   388	        halo += decomposition.nx;
   389	        device.host_recv_left = halo;
   390	        halo += decomposition.nx;
   391	        device.host_recv_right = halo;
   392	        std::fill(device.host_halos, device.host_halos + halo_elements, 0.0);
   393	    }
   394	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   395	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&device.boundary_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   396	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_ready[0],
   397	                                        cudaEventDisableTiming));
   398	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_ready[1],
   399	                                        cudaEventDisableTiming));
   400	
   401	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.energy, 0,
   402	                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
   403	                               device.boundary_stream));
   404	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.energy_swap, 0,
   405	                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
   406	                               device.boundary_stream));
   407	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.total_flux, 0,
   408	                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
   409	                               device.boundary_stream));
   410	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.total_flux_swap, 0,
   411	                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
   412	                               device.boundary_stream));
   413	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.recv_left, 0,
   414	                               static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * sizeof(val_t),
   415	                               device.boundary_stream));
   416	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.recv_right, 0,
   417	                               static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * sizeof(val_t),
   418	                               device.boundary_stream));
   419	
   420	    constexpr int threads = 256;
   421	    const int blocks = (decomposition.nx + threads - 1) / threads;
   422	    packColumnsKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, device.boundary_stream>>>(
   423	        device.energy, device.send_left, device.send_right,
   424	        decomposition.nx, decomposition.ny, static_cast<int>(device.pitch));
   425	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   426	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(device.interior_ready[0], device.boundary_stream));
   427	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(device.interior_ready[1], device.boundary_stream));
   428	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(device.boundary_stream));
   429	    return device;
   430	}
   431	
   432	void freeDeviceDomain(DeviceDomain& device) {
   433	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(device.interior_ready[0]));
   434	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(device.interior_ready[1]));
   435	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(device.interior_stream));
   436	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(device.boundary_stream));
   437	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(device.energy));
   438	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(device.energy_swap));
   439	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(device.total_flux));
   440	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(device.total_flux_swap));
   441	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(device.send_left));
   442	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(device.send_right));
   443	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(device.recv_left));
   444	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(device.recv_right));
   445	    if (device.host_halos != nullptr) {
   446	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(device.host_halos));
   447	    }
   448	}
   449	
   450	int boundaryElementCount(int nx, int ny) {
   451	    if (nx == 1) {
   452	        return ny;
   453	    }
   454	    return 2 * ny + std::max(nx - 2, 0) * (ny == 1 ? 1 : 2);
   455	}
   456	
   457	void runSimulation(DeviceDomain& device, const Decomposition& decomposition,
   458	                   int n_elems_root, int n_iters) {
   459	    constexpr int TAG_X_MINUS = 100;
   460	    constexpr int TAG_X_PLUS = 101;
   461	    constexpr int TAG_Y_MINUS = 102;
   462	    constexpr int TAG_Y_PLUS = 103;
   463	    constexpr int boundary_threads = 256;
   464	    const int pitch = static_cast<int>(device.pitch);
   465	    const int boundary_elements = boundaryElementCount(decomposition.nx, decomposition.ny);
   466	    const int boundary_blocks =
   467	        (boundary_elements + boundary_threads - 1) / boundary_threads;
   468	    int current_slot = 0;
   469	
   470	    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
   471	        // Only the local perimeter is needed by MPI.  It is produced on a
   472	        // separate stream so communication can start while the prior interior
   473	        // work (which is ordered on interior_stream) is still completing.
   474	        if (!device.cuda_aware_mpi) {
   475	            const size_t row_bytes =
   476	                static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) * sizeof(val_t);
   477	            const size_t column_bytes =
   478	                static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * sizeof(val_t);
   479	            if (decomposition.x_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   480	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
   481	                    device.host_send_top, device.energy + pitch + 1, row_bytes,
   482	                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, device.boundary_stream));
   483	            }
   484	            if (decomposition.x_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   485	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
   486	                    device.host_send_bottom,
   487	                    device.energy +
   488	                        static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * pitch + 1,
   489	                    row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, device.boundary_stream));
   490	            }
   491	            if (decomposition.y_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   492	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(device.host_send_left, device.send_left,
   493	                                           column_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   494	                                           device.boundary_stream));
   495	            }
   496	            if (decomposition.y_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   497	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(device.host_send_right, device.send_right,
   498	                                           column_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   499	                                           device.boundary_stream));
   500	            }
   501	        }
   502	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(device.boundary_stream));
   503	
   504	        val_t* recv_top = device.cuda_aware_mpi
   505	                              ? device.energy + 1
   506	                              : device.host_recv_top;
   507	        val_t* recv_bottom =
   508	            device.cuda_aware_mpi
   509	                ? device.energy +
   510	                      static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx + 1) * pitch + 1
   511	                : device.host_recv_bottom;
   512	        val_t* recv_left =
   513	            device.cuda_aware_mpi ? device.recv_left : device.host_recv_left;
   514	        val_t* recv_right =
   515	            device.cuda_aware_mpi ? device.recv_right : device.host_recv_right;
   516	        const val_t* send_top = device.cuda_aware_mpi
   517	                                    ? device.energy + pitch + 1
   518	                                    : device.host_send_top;
   519	        const val_t* send_bottom =
   520	            device.cuda_aware_mpi
   521	                ? device.energy +
   522	                      static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * pitch + 1
   523	                : device.host_send_bottom;
   524	        const val_t* send_left =
   525	            device.cuda_aware_mpi ? device.send_left : device.host_send_left;
   526	        const val_t* send_right =
   527	            device.cuda_aware_mpi ? device.send_right : device.host_send_right;
   528	
   529	        MPI_Request requests[8];
   530	        int request_count = 0;
   531	        if (decomposition.x_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   532	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(recv_top, decomposition.ny, MPI_DOUBLE,
   533	                                decomposition.x_minus, TAG_X_PLUS,
   534	                                decomposition.cart, &requests[request_count++]));
   535	        }
   536	        if (decomposition.x_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   537	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(recv_bottom, decomposition.ny, MPI_DOUBLE,
   538	                                decomposition.x_plus, TAG_X_MINUS,
   539	                                decomposition.cart, &requests[request_count++]));
   540	        }
   541	        if (decomposition.y_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   542	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(recv_left, decomposition.nx, MPI_DOUBLE,
   543	                                decomposition.y_minus, TAG_Y_PLUS,
   544	                                decomposition.cart, &requests[request_count++]));
   545	        }
   546	        if (decomposition.y_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   547	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(recv_right, decomposition.nx, MPI_DOUBLE,
   548	                                decomposition.y_plus, TAG_Y_MINUS,
   549	                                decomposition.cart, &requests[request_count++]));
   550	        }
   551	
   552	        if (decomposition.x_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   553	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send_top, decomposition.ny, MPI_DOUBLE,
   554	                                decomposition.x_minus, TAG_X_MINUS,
   555	                                decomposition.cart, &requests[request_count++]));
   556	        }
   557	        if (decomposition.x_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   558	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send_bottom, decomposition.ny, MPI_DOUBLE,
   559	                                decomposition.x_plus, TAG_X_PLUS,
   560	                                decomposition.cart, &requests[request_count++]));
   561	        }
   562	        if (decomposition.y_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   563	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send_left, decomposition.nx, MPI_DOUBLE,
   564	                                decomposition.y_minus, TAG_Y_MINUS,
   565	                                decomposition.cart, &requests[request_count++]));
   566	        }
   567	        if (decomposition.y_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   568	            MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(send_right, decomposition.nx, MPI_DOUBLE,
   569	                                decomposition.y_plus, TAG_Y_PLUS,
   570	                                decomposition.cart, &requests[request_count++]));
   571	        }
   572	
   573	        if (decomposition.nx > 2 && decomposition.ny > 2) {
   574	            const dim3 threads(TILE_X, TILE_Y);
   575	            const dim3 blocks((decomposition.ny - 2 + TILE_X - 1) / TILE_X,
   576	                              (decomposition.nx - 2 + TILE_Y - 1) / TILE_Y);
   577	            updateInteriorKernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, device.interior_stream>>>(
   578	                device.energy, device.total_flux, device.energy_swap,
   579	                device.total_flux_swap, decomposition.nx, decomposition.ny, pitch);
   580	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   581	        }
   582	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(device.interior_ready[1 - current_slot],
   583	                                   device.interior_stream));
   584	
   585	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   586	
   587	        // A perimeter update reads the immediately adjacent interior of the
   588	        // current buffer.  Track readiness per ping-pong buffer so this wait
   589	        // does not unnecessarily serialize it behind this iteration's
   590	        // independent interior work.
   800	        return false;
   801	    }
   802	    if (std::abs(energy_sum) > energy_epsilon) {
   803	        std::printf("  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\n");
   804	    }
   805	    if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {
   806	        std::printf("  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\n");
   807	        return false;
   808	    }
   809	    if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {
   810	        std::printf("  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\n");
   811	        return false;
   812	    }
   813	
   814	    std::printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
   815	    return true;
   816	}
   817	
   818	void printUsage(const char* program_name) {
   819	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", program_name);
   820	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   821	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Grid size (NxN elements) (default: 512)\n");
   822	    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of simulation iterations (default: 10)\n");
   823	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   824	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   825	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   826	}
   827	
   828	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   829	    int provided_thread_level = 0;
   830	    const int init_error =
   831	        MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided_thread_level);
   832	    if (init_error != MPI_SUCCESS) {
   833	        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI_Init_thread failed\n");
   834	        return 1;
   835	    }
   836	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
   837	    if (provided_thread_level < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   838	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   839	            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI does not provide the required FUNNELED thread level.\n");
   840	        }
   841	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
   842	    }
   843	
   844	    int n_elems_root = 512;
   845	    int n_iters = 10;
   846	    bool validate = false;
   847	    bool print_results_requested = false;
   848	    bool arguments_valid = true;
   849	    bool help_requested = false;
   850	
   851	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   852	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   853	            n_elems_root = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   854	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   855	            n_iters = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   856	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   857	            validate = true;
   858	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   859	            print_results_requested = true;
   860	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   861	            help_requested = true;
   862	        } else {
   863	            if (world_rank == 0) {
   864	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   865	            }
   866	            arguments_valid = false;
   867	        }
   868	    }
   869	
   870	    if (n_elems_root <= 0 || n_iters < 0) {
   871	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   872	            std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid size must be positive and iterations nonnegative.\n");
   873	        }
   874	        arguments_valid = false;
   875	    }
   876	    if (help_requested || !arguments_valid) {
   877	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   878	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   879	        }
   880	        MPI_Finalize();
   881	        return arguments_valid ? 0 : 1;
   882	    }
   883	
   884	    MPI_Comm local_comm = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   885	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, world_rank,
   886	                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_comm));
   887	    int local_rank = 0;
   888	    int local_size = 1;
   889	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_comm, &local_rank));
   890	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(local_comm, &local_size));
   891	
   892	    int device_count = 0;
   893	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
   894	    if (device_count == 0) {
   895	        abortWithMessage("CUDA", "cudaGetDeviceCount", "no CUDA devices found",
   896	                         __FILE__, __LINE__);
   897	    }
   898	    const int device_id = local_rank % device_count;
   899	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device_id));
   900	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
   901	    cudaDeviceProp device_properties{};
   902	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&device_properties, device_id));
   903	
   904	    if (std::getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS") == nullptr) {
   905	        const int threads_per_rank =
   906	            std::max(1, std::min(32, omp_get_num_procs() / local_size));
   907	        omp_set_num_threads(threads_per_rank);
   908	    }
   909	
   910	    Decomposition decomposition = makeDecomposition(n_elems_root);
   911	    const bool cuda_aware_mpi = cudaAwareMpiAvailable();
   912	    DeviceDomain device = allocateDeviceDomain(decomposition, cuda_aware_mpi);
   913	
   914	    const uint64_t n_elems =
   915	        static_cast<uint64_t>(n_elems_root) * n_elems_root;
   916	    const size_t logical_static_mem = n_elems * sizeof(ElementStatic);
   917	    const size_t logical_dynamic_mem = n_elems * sizeof(ElementDynamic) * 2;
   918	    const uint64_t local_device_mem =
   919	        (4 * device.allocation_elements + 4 * static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx)) *
   920	        sizeof(val_t);
   921	    uint64_t max_device_mem = 0;
   922	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_device_mem, &max_device_mem, 1, MPI_UINT64_T,
   923	                         MPI_MAX, 0, decomposition.cart));
   924	
   925	    if (world_rank == 0) {
   926	        std::printf("Unstructured Mesh Energy Transfer Benchmark\n");
   927	        std::printf("============================================\n");
   928	        std::printf("Grid size: %d x %d = %" PRIu64 " elements\n",
   929	                    n_elems_root, n_elems_root, n_elems);
   930	        std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", n_iters);
   931	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   932	        std::printf("Hybrid execution: %d MPI ranks (%d x %d), up to %d OpenMP threads/rank\n",
   933	                    decomposition.size, decomposition.dims[0], decomposition.dims[1],
   934	                    omp_get_max_threads());
   935	        std::printf("CUDA devices/node: %d (%s on rank 0)\n", device_count,
   936	                    device_properties.name);
   937	        std::printf("MPI halo transport: %s\n",
   938	                    cuda_aware_mpi ? "direct CUDA-aware device buffers"
   939	                                   : "portable pinned-host staging");
   940	        std::printf("Building distributed unstructured mesh...\n");
   941	        std::printf("Logical memory: %.2f MB (static: %.2f MB, dynamic: %.2f MB)\n",
   942	                    (logical_static_mem + logical_dynamic_mem) / (1024.0 * 1024.0),
   943	                    logical_static_mem / (1024.0 * 1024.0),
   944	                    logical_dynamic_mem / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
   945	        std::printf("Maximum CUDA memory/rank: %.2f MB\n\n",
   946	                    max_device_mem / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
   947	        std::printf("Running simulation...\n");
   948	    }
   949	
   950	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(decomposition.cart));
   951	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   952	    runSimulation(device, decomposition, n_elems_root, n_iters);
   953	    const double local_seconds = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   954	    double elapsed_seconds = 0.0;
   955	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_seconds, &elapsed_seconds, 1, MPI_DOUBLE,
   956	                         MPI_MAX, 0, decomposition.cart));
   957	
   958	    std::vector<val_t> local_energy;
   959	    std::vector<val_t> local_flux;
   960	    copyLocalResults(device, decomposition, local_energy, local_flux);
   961	    const uint64_t result_hash = computeDistributedHash(
   962	        local_energy, local_flux, decomposition, n_elems_root);
   963	
   964	    if (world_rank == 0) {
   965	        const double duration_ms = elapsed_seconds * 1000.0;
   966	        const int n_measured_iters = std::max(n_iters - 1, 1);
   967	        const double time_per_iter = duration_ms / n_measured_iters;
   968	        const double giga_elements_per_second =
   969	            elapsed_seconds > 0.0
   970	                ? (static_cast<double>(n_measured_iters) * n_elems) /
   971	                      elapsed_seconds / 1.0e9
   972	                : 0.0;
   973	        const double gflops = giga_elements_per_second * 22.0;
   974	
   975	        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", duration_ms);
   976	        std::printf("Performance:\n");
   977	        std::printf("  Time per iteration: %.4f ms\n", time_per_iter);
   978	        std::printf("  Elements/sec: %.4f GigaElements/s\n",
   979	                    giga_elements_per_second);
   980	        std::printf("  Performance: %.4f GFLOPS\n", gflops);
   981	        std::printf("  Result hash: %016" PRIX64 "\n\n", result_hash);
   982	    }
   983	
   984	    std::vector<ElementDynamic> global_results;
   985	    if (print_results_requested || validate) {
   986	        global_results = gatherResults(local_energy, local_flux,
   987	                                       decomposition, n_elems_root);
   988	    }
   989	
   990	    int exit_status = 0;
   991	    if (world_rank == 0 && print_results_requested) {
   992	        std::vector<val_t> energy_data(global_results.size());
   993	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)
   994	        for (int64_t i = 0; i < static_cast<int64_t>(global_results.size()); ++i) {
   995	            energy_data[i] = global_results[i].current_energy;
   996	        }
   997	        print_results(energy_data, "ElementEnergy");
   998	    }
   999	    if (world_rank == 0 && validate && !validateResults(global_results)) {
  1000	        exit_status = 1;
  1001	    }
  1002	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&exit_status, 1, MPI_INT, 0, decomposition.cart));
  1003	
  1004	    freeDeviceDomain(device);
  1005	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&decomposition.cart));
  1006	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_comm));
  1007	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Finalize());
  1008	    return exit_status;
  1009	}

     3	# CUDA 12.0 in the benchmark image supports GCC 12 as its newest host
     4	# compiler, while the image's default compiler is newer.  Keep user/toolchain
     5	# selections authoritative and choose the compatible compiler only when it is
     6	# available and no explicit selection was made.
     7	if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER AND EXISTS "/usr/bin/g++-12")
     8	    set(CMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER "/usr/bin/g++-12" CACHE FILEPATH
     9	        "Host compiler used by NVCC")
    10	endif()
    11	if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)
    12	    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native CACHE STRING
    13	        "CUDA architectures to compile for")
    14	endif()

    19	find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)
    20	find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)

    23	set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

    28	# unit as CUDA rather than adding a separate .cu file.
    29	set_source_files_properties(unstructured.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)
    30	add_executable(unstructured unstructured.cpp)

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {

+void checkMpi(int error, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+        abortWithMessage("MPI", expression, message, file, line);

+#define MPI_CHECK(call) checkMpi((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_x, int global_y,
+                                              int n_elems_root) {
+    const int last = n_elems_root - 1;
+    if ((global_x == 0 && global_y == 0) ||
+        (global_x == last && global_y == last)) {
+        return 0.5;
+    }
+    if ((global_x == 0 && global_y == last) ||
+        (global_x == last && global_y == 0)) {
+        return -0.5;
+    }
+    return 0.0;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t computeFluxDevice(val_t center,
+                                                   val_t neighbor) {
+    // Explicit round-to-nearest operations preserve the original CPU
+    // expression's operation boundaries; in particular, CUDA must not fuse
+    // the final multiply with the running flux sum.
+    const val_t difference = __dsub_rn(neighbor, center);
+    const val_t transferred = __dmul_rn(difference, 0.8);
+    return __dmul_rn(transferred, 0.25);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void updatePoint(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ energy_swap,
+    val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux_swap,
+    val_t* __restrict__ send_left,
+    val_t* __restrict__ send_right,
+    int local_x, int local_y, int nx, int ny, int pitch,
+    int x_start, int y_start, int n_elems_root) {
+    const int global_x = x_start + local_x - 1;
+    const int global_y = y_start + local_y - 1;
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y;
+    const val_t center = energy[index];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_x, global_y, n_elems_root);
+
+    // Keep the original connection order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    if (global_x + 1 < n_elems_root) {
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index + pitch]));
+    }
+    if (global_x > 0) {
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index - pitch]));
+    }
+    if (global_y + 1 < n_elems_root) {
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index + 1]));
+    }
+    if (global_y > 0) {
+        flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, energy[index - 1]));
+    }
+
+    const val_t new_energy = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    energy_swap[index] = new_energy;
+    accumulated_flux_swap[index] =
+        __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[index], fabs(flux));
+
+    // Packing the next iteration's noncontiguous column halos here removes a
+    // separate read of each boundary column.
+    if (local_y == 1) {
+        send_left[local_x - 1] = new_energy;
+    }
+    if (local_y == ny) {
+        send_right[local_x - 1] = new_energy;
+    }
+}
+
+constexpr int TILE_X = 32;
+constexpr int TILE_Y = 8;
+
+__global__ void updateInteriorKernel(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ energy,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ energy_swap,
+    val_t* __restrict__ accumulated_flux_swap,
+    int nx, int ny, int pitch) {
+    __shared__ val_t tile[TILE_Y + 2][TILE_X + 2];
+
+    const int block_row = 2 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * TILE_Y;
+    const int block_col = 2 + static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * TILE_X;
+    const int linear_thread = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) * TILE_X + threadIdx.x;
+    constexpr int tile_elements = (TILE_Y + 2) * (TILE_X + 2);
+    constexpr int block_threads = TILE_X * TILE_Y;
+
+    for (int item = linear_thread; item < tile_elements; item += block_threads) {
+        const int tile_row = item / (TILE_X + 2);
+        const int tile_col = item % (TILE_X + 2);
+        const int local_x = block_row + tile_row - 1;
+        const int local_y = block_col + tile_col - 1;
+        val_t value = 0.0;
+        if (local_x >= 1 && local_x <= nx && local_y >= 1 && local_y <= ny) {
+            value = energy[static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y];
+        }
+        tile[tile_row][tile_col] = value;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const int local_x = block_row + threadIdx.y;
+    const int local_y = block_col + threadIdx.x;
+    if (local_x >= nx || local_y >= ny) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int shared_x = threadIdx.y + 1;
+    const int shared_y = threadIdx.x + 1;
+    const val_t center = tile[shared_x][shared_y];
+    val_t flux = 0.0;
+    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x + 1][shared_y]));
+    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x - 1][shared_y]));
+    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x][shared_y + 1]));
+    flux = __dadd_rn(flux, computeFluxDevice(center, tile[shared_x][shared_y - 1]));
+
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_x) * pitch + local_y;
+    energy_swap[index] = __dadd_rn(center, flux);
+    accumulated_flux_swap[index] =
+        __dadd_rn(accumulated_flux[index], fabs(flux));
+}

+    if (item >= boundary_elements) {
+        return;

+int partitionExtent(int global_extent, int parts, int coordinate) {
+    const int base = global_extent / parts;
+    const int remainder = global_extent % parts;
+    return base + (coordinate < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+}
+
+int partitionStart(int global_extent, int parts, int coordinate) {
+    const int base = global_extent / parts;
+    const int remainder = global_extent % parts;
+    return coordinate * base + std::min(coordinate, remainder);
+}
+
+Decomposition makeDecomposition(int n_elems_root) {
+    Decomposition domain;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &domain.size));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Dims_create(domain.size, 2, domain.dims));
+    if (domain.dims[0] > n_elems_root || domain.dims[1] > n_elems_root) {
+        if (world_rank == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "The %d x %d MPI process grid exceeds the %d x %d mesh.\n",
+                         domain.dims[0], domain.dims[1], n_elems_root, n_elems_root);
         }
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    }
+
+    const int periods[2] = {0, 0};
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_create(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2, domain.dims, periods, 0,
+                              &domain.cart));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(domain.cart, &domain.rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_coords(domain.cart, domain.rank, 2, domain.coords));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_shift(domain.cart, 0, 1, &domain.x_minus, &domain.x_plus));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Cart_shift(domain.cart, 1, 1, &domain.y_minus, &domain.y_plus));
+
+    domain.nx = partitionExtent(n_elems_root, domain.dims[0], domain.coords[0]);
+    domain.ny = partitionExtent(n_elems_root, domain.dims[1], domain.coords[1]);
+    domain.x_start = partitionStart(n_elems_root, domain.dims[0], domain.coords[0]);
+    domain.y_start = partitionStart(n_elems_root, domain.dims[1], domain.coords[1]);
+    return domain;
+}

+template <typename T>
+void allocateDevice(T** pointer, size_t count) {
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(pointer), count * sizeof(T)));
+}
+
+bool cudaAwareMpiAvailable() {
+    const char* override_value = std::getenv("UNSTRUCTURED_CUDA_AWARE_MPI");
+    if (override_value != nullptr) {
+        return std::atoi(override_value) != 0;
+    }
+#if defined(OPEN_MPI) && defined(OMPI_HAVE_MPI_EXT_CUDA)
+    return MPIX_Query_cuda_support() != 0;
+#else
+    // Unknown MPI implementations use the portable pinned-memory path.  A
+    // CUDA-aware installation can opt into its direct path with the environment
+    // variable above without requiring a rebuild.
+    return false;
+#endif
+}

+DeviceDomain allocateDeviceDomain(const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                                  bool cuda_aware_mpi) {
+    DeviceDomain device;
+    device.cuda_aware_mpi = cuda_aware_mpi;
+    device.pitch = static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) + 2;
+    device.allocation_elements =
+        (static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) + 2) * device.pitch;
+
+    allocateDevice(&device.energy, device.allocation_elements);
+    allocateDevice(&device.energy_swap, device.allocation_elements);
+    allocateDevice(&device.total_flux, device.allocation_elements);
+    allocateDevice(&device.total_flux_swap, device.allocation_elements);
+    allocateDevice(&device.send_left, decomposition.nx);
+    allocateDevice(&device.send_right, decomposition.nx);
+    allocateDevice(&device.recv_left, decomposition.nx);
+    allocateDevice(&device.recv_right, decomposition.nx);
+    const bool has_neighbor =
+        decomposition.x_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+        decomposition.x_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+        decomposition.y_minus != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+        decomposition.y_plus != MPI_PROC_NULL;
+    if (!device.cuda_aware_mpi && has_neighbor) {
+        const size_t halo_elements =
+            4 * static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) +
+            4 * static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device.host_halos),
+                                  halo_elements * sizeof(val_t)));
+        val_t* halo = device.host_halos;
+        device.host_send_top = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.ny;
+        device.host_send_bottom = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.ny;
+        device.host_recv_top = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.ny;
+        device.host_recv_bottom = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.ny;
+        device.host_send_left = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.nx;
+        device.host_send_right = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.nx;
+        device.host_recv_left = halo;
+        halo += decomposition.nx;
+        device.host_recv_right = halo;
+        std::fill(device.host_halos, device.host_halos + halo_elements, 0.0);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&device.boundary_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_ready[0],
+                                        cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&device.interior_ready[1],
+                                        cudaEventDisableTiming));
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.energy, 0,
+                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.energy_swap, 0,
+                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.total_flux, 0,
+                               device.allocation_elements * sizeof(val_t),
+                               device.boundary_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(device.total_flux_swap, 0,

+void copyLocalResults(const DeviceDomain& device,
+                      const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                      std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                      std::vector<val_t>& flux) {
+    const size_t local_elements =
+        static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.nx) * decomposition.ny;
+    energy.resize(local_elements);
+    flux.resize(local_elements);
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.ny) * sizeof(val_t);
+    const val_t* energy_start = device.energy + device.pitch + 1;
+    const val_t* flux_start = device.total_flux + device.pitch + 1;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(energy.data(), row_bytes, energy_start,
+                            device.pitch * sizeof(val_t), row_bytes,
+                            decomposition.nx, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(flux.data(), row_bytes, flux_start,
+                            device.pitch * sizeof(val_t), row_bytes,
+                            decomposition.nx, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+}

+uint64_t computeDistributedHash(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                                const std::vector<val_t>& flux,
+                                const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                                int n_elems_root) {
+    uint64_t local_hash = 0;
+    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : local_hash)
+    for (int64_t local_index = 0; local_index < count; ++local_index) {
+        const int local_x = static_cast<int>(local_index / decomposition.ny);
+        const int local_y = static_cast<int>(local_index % decomposition.ny);
+        const uint64_t global_index =
+            static_cast<uint64_t>(decomposition.x_start + local_x) * n_elems_root +
+            decomposition.y_start + local_y;
+        uint64_t energy_bits;
+        uint64_t flux_bits;
+        std::memcpy(&energy_bits, &energy[local_index], sizeof(energy_bits));
+        std::memcpy(&flux_bits, &flux[local_index], sizeof(flux_bits));
+        local_hash ^= (energy_bits + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        local_hash ^= (flux_bits + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    }
+
+    uint64_t global_hash = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_hash, &global_hash, 1, MPI_UINT64_T,
+                         MPI_BXOR, 0, decomposition.cart));
+    return global_hash;
+}

+std::vector<ElementDynamic> gatherResults(const std::vector<val_t>& local_energy,
+                                          const std::vector<val_t>& local_flux,
+                                          const Decomposition& decomposition,
+                                          int n_elems_root) {
+    if (local_energy.size() > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
+        abortWithMessage("MPI", "MPI_Gatherv count", "local domain is too large",
+                         __FILE__, __LINE__);
+    }
+
+    const int local_count = static_cast<int>(local_energy.size());
+    const int metadata[4] = {decomposition.x_start, decomposition.y_start,
+                             decomposition.nx, decomposition.ny};
+    std::vector<int> all_metadata;
+    std::vector<int> counts;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        all_metadata.resize(static_cast<size_t>(decomposition.size) * 4);
+        counts.resize(decomposition.size);
+    }
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gather(metadata, 4, MPI_INT, all_metadata.data(), 4, MPI_INT,
+                         0, decomposition.cart));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gather(&local_count, 1, MPI_INT, counts.data(), 1, MPI_INT,
+                         0, decomposition.cart));
+
+    std::vector<int> displacements;
+    std::vector<val_t> gathered_energy;
+    std::vector<val_t> gathered_flux;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        displacements.resize(decomposition.size);
+        int total = 0;
+        for (int rank = 0; rank < decomposition.size; ++rank) {
+            displacements[rank] = total;
+            if (counts[rank] > std::numeric_limits<int>::max() - total) {
+                abortWithMessage("MPI", "MPI_Gatherv displacement",
+                                 "global result is too large", __FILE__, __LINE__);
+            }
+            total += counts[rank];
+        }
+        gathered_energy.resize(total);
+        gathered_flux.resize(total);
+    }
+
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(local_energy.data(), local_count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          gathered_energy.data(), counts.data(), displacements.data(),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, decomposition.cart));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Gatherv(local_flux.data(), local_count, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          gathered_flux.data(), counts.data(), displacements.data(),
+                          MPI_DOUBLE, 0, decomposition.cart));
+
+    std::vector<ElementDynamic> global_results;
+    if (decomposition.rank == 0) {
+        global_results.resize(static_cast<size_t>(n_elems_root) * n_elems_root);
+
+        // All OpenMP workers cooperate on each MPI block.  This avoids races
+        // and retains global row-major ordering for output and validation.
+#pragma omp parallel
+        {
+            for (int rank = 0; rank < decomposition.size; ++rank) {
+                const int x_start = all_metadata[4 * rank];
+                const int y_start = all_metadata[4 * rank + 1];
+                const int nx = all_metadata[4 * rank + 2];
+                const int ny = all_metadata[4 * rank + 3];
+#pragma omp for schedule(static)
+                for (int local_index = 0; local_index < counts[rank]; ++local_index) {
+                    const int local_x = local_index / ny;
+                    const int local_y = local_index % ny;
+                    const size_t global_index =
+                        static_cast<size_t>(x_start + local_x) * n_elems_root +
+                        y_start + local_y;
+                    const int gathered_index = displacements[rank] + local_index;
+                    global_results[global_index] =
+                        ElementDynamic{gathered_energy[gathered_index],
+                                       gathered_flux[gathered_index]};
+                }
+                (void)nx;
+            }
+        }
     }
+    return global_results;
 }

Implemented the unconditional MPI + OpenMP + CUDA hybrid benchmark in existing files only.

- 2-D Cartesian MPI decomposition with nonblocking halo exchange.
- CUDA tiled stencil kernels, dual streams, ping-pong buffers, and communication overlap.
- Automatic CUDA-aware MPI transfers with pinned-host fallback.
- OpenMP-parallel hashing, gathering, and result processing.
- Bit-for-bit result hashes match the original across 1–6 ranks and edge cases.
- Preserved executable name `unstructured`.
- Clean CUDA/CMake build verified.
- On the test RTX 3090: default workload improved from 22 ms to 0.35 ms; a 4096² workload achieved ~3.1× scaling across four GPUs.

+[[noreturn]] void abortWithMessage(const char* kind, const char* expression,
+                                   const char* detail, const char* file, int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s failure at %s:%d: %s (%s)\n",
+                 world_rank, kind, file, line, expression, detail);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    std::abort();
+}

+void checkCuda(cudaError_t error, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != cudaSuccess) {
+        abortWithMessage("CUDA", expression, cudaGetErrorString(error), file, line);
+    }
+}

+void checkMpi(int error, const char* expression, const char* file, int line) {
+    if (error != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+        int length = 0;
+        MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+        abortWithMessage("MPI", expression, message, file, line);
+    }
+}
